summary:
Patient Overview
Yasmeen Pervaiz, a 65-year-old retired school teacher, presents with chronic right knee pain and stiffness consistent with early-to-moderate osteoarthritis. Patient also has well-controlled mild hypertension and reports recurrent ear infections requiring hearing aid use.

Key Findings
• CBC (2025-07-11) shows normal hematologic parameters with appropriate differential count
• Synovial fluid analysis (2025-07-12) shows light yellow, transparent fluid with minimal WBC count and no organisms, ruling out infectious or inflammatory arthritis
• Blood pressure well-controlled at 127/82 mmHg on current medication
• Mild effusion and tenderness over medial joint line of right knee noted on examination
• BMI of 26 indicates slight overweight status

Risk Assessment
Low to moderate risk for progression of osteoarthritis with current activity limitations. Patient demonstrates good medication compliance for hypertension management. Hearing impairment may affect communication and quality of life. Recommend weight management and physical therapy to prevent further joint deterioration and improve mobility.

Recommendations
• Obtain knee X-ray to confirm extent of degenerative changes
• Continue Nifedipine 20mg once daily for hypertension management
• Consider intra-articular corticosteroid injection if conservative management insufficient
• Refer to physiotherapy for strengthening exercises and joint protection techniques
• Encourage low-impact exercises such as swimming or cycling
• Weight management counseling to reduce joint stress
• Regular blood pressure monitoring
• ENT follow-up for recurrent ear infections and hearing aid management
